title: skills command is registered in the commands array
test_data: { id: 'skills', description: 'Add a skill to current profile', usage: '' }
steps: Verify it exists and has correct description and usage
expected_result: skills command entry exists with description mentioning 'skill' and no usage hint

title: filterCommands matches skills by prefix
expected_result: All prefix queries return the skills command
notes: 's' prefix already matches 4 commands; adding skills makes 5

title: filterCommands is case-insensitive for skills
expected_result: Uppercase query matches the skills command

title: pickerModeForCommand returns 'skills' for skills command
preconditions: picker-items.ts has 'skills' in ChoicePickerMode and pickerModeForCommand

title: discovered skills convert to picker options
preconditions: SKILL.md files exist in test directory with frontmatter name and description
test_data: Two skills: 'alpha' with description 'Alpha skill', 'beta' with description 'Beta skill'
steps: Create temp directory with two SKILL.md files
Map results to PickerOption[] format {id, name}
Verify each skill has id === name and name is the skill name
notes: The handleGetSkills function in index.tsx will do this mapping

title: buildPickerItems works with skill options
test_data: Two skill options: alpha, beta. Current skills: ['alpha']
steps: Call buildPickerItems with skill options and empty currentId
Verify all skills appear as picker entries
Verify items have id, label, detail fields
expected_result: All skill options appear as picker entries with correct fields
notes: Since multiple skills can be 'current', a single currentId won't mark all bound skills

title: Adding a skill name to activeAgent.skills array
expected_result: New skill is appended to the skills array
notes: This is an in-memory mutation, not persisted to disk

title: buildSystem reflects newly added skill's L1 metadata
preconditions: SKILL.md files created with L1 metadata. skill name added to agent.skills
steps: Create skill file for 'git-release' with description 'Manage git releases'
Verify system prompt includes '# Available Skills'
Verify system prompt includes 'git-release' and 'Manage git releases'
Verify L2 content (skill body) is NOT in system prompt
expected_result: System prompt includes L1 metadata for git-release but not L2 body content
notes: This verifies the core feature: adding skill → system prompt update

title: Adding an already-bound skill is detected and skipped
steps: Check if 'code-review' is already in agent.skills
In the command handler, do NOT add duplicate skill
expected_result: Duplicate is detected; skill is not added again; info toast is shown instead
notes: Duplicate detection should be a simple array check

title: buildSkillTool reflects expanded boundSkills after adding skill
preconditions: Two SKILL.md files created. Initially only one is bound.
steps: Verify tool description includes 'alpha' but NOT 'beta'
Verify tool description now includes BOTH 'alpha' and 'beta'
expected_result: Tool description updates to include newly added skill
notes: This is what happens when the skill tool is re-registered after /skills adds a skill

title: Handle case when no skills are discovered
preconditions: No SKILL.md files in search directories
steps: Map to PickerOption[] — should also be empty
buildPickerItems with empty options should return empty array
expected_result: Empty picker items when no skills exist
notes: The picker should show 'No skills available' message

title: Filter skill picker items by query
steps: Build picker items from skill options
notes: buildPickerItems already supports query filtering by id or name

title: Switching profiles resets skills to new profile's defaults
preconditions: /skills was used to add skill X to profile A
test_data: Switch from profile A (with added skill) to profile B
steps: Verify that skills added via /skills are NOT persisted across profile switches
After switching profiles, agent.skills should match only the new profile's declared skills
expected_result: Temporary skills are cleared on profile switch
notes: This is an in-memory-only feature — profile switch resets via agentFromProfile
